The '''Nova Orion Crisis''' occurred in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], when the founders on [[Nova Orion Industries]], [[Jonas Nova]] and [[Garrick Orion]], attempted to pull apart the company due to a gulf of suspicion between them.

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Nova Orion Crisis appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
